title: Update the tvb_get API calls in our ASN.1 dissectors
description:
Run

    sed -i -e 's/tvb_get_guint/tvb_get_uint/g' -e 's/tvb_get_gint/tvb_get_int/g'

on our ASN.1 templates and conformance files and regenerate our
dissectors. Update packet-ber.c as well.

Ping #19116
